name: towles-tool
comment:engines: Bun is the package manager and script runner. Node stays a prerequisite because the scripts/*.mjs dev tooling and the WebdriverIO e2e suite still run on the Node runtime.

scripts.clean: cargo clean && rm -rf apps/client/dist node_modules apps/client/node_modules

comment:overrides: @wdio/tauri-service@1.2.0 exact-pins @wdio/native-utils@2.4.0 but imports installMockSyncOverride, only added in 2.5.0 — a broken pin. Force 2.5.0 until upstream fixes it. The @codingame/monaco-vscode-* tree must dedupe to one copy: two copies of the same VS Code services meant two CommandsRegistry instances, both registering editor.action.measureExtHostLatency and crashing with 'Cannot register two commands with the same id'. Force the two roots the rest of the tree pins against to one version.
comment:trusted-dependencies: Deliberately empty. `bun install` blocks edgedriver's postinstall, which downloads an Edge WebDriver binary; the e2e suite drives WebKitGTK via webkit2gtk-driver and never touches it, so the 'Blocked 1 postinstall' line is expected. Don't `bun pm trust` it.
comment:overrides-audit: The rest hold `bun audit` at 0, forcing advisory fixes past a parent's stale pin; drop each when upstream catches up. dompurify: monaco-vscode-api exact-pins 3.4.11. serialize-javascript: mocha pins ^6.0.2 and 6.x got no backport. @hono/node-server: patched only in 2.x, and the SDK's one getRequestListener import survives the major. minimatch: brace-expansion is patched only in 5.0.8, which only minimatch >=10.2 depends on, so one pin clears ~20 nodes across glob/jake/mocha/wdio. Its cost is `mocha --ignore`, which calls minimatch as a function — CLI-only, and wdio drives mocha programmatically. Unavoidable anyway: mocha 12 takes minimatch 10 but renames the lib/cli/run-helpers.js that @wdio/mocha-framework deep-imports.
